testedSource.basis: Canonical LF for text; exact binary assets. Identity is not semantic parity.

tests.skipExplanation: The offscreen WebView case has a passing Windows counterpart. Any workspace-tree link case listed as skipped requires Windows symbolic-link privilege; it is not counted as tested. native_notification_sounds and native_power_request each skip one opt-in real-device smoke (ADE_AUDIO_SMOKE / ADE_POWER_SMOKE); the power smoke passed separately (optInDeviceSmokes), the audio smoke was not run.

optInDeviceSmokes.audio: not run: plays audible tones on the owner machine; synthesized PCM output path covered only by stubbed tests

coveredChanges: Includes checkpoint 11 (failed-turn Retry, notification sounds, keep-awake, single instance, shortcut slices S1-S4/S7, uniform read-only line numbers).
The failed-turn error is shown inside the Retry card like upstream GenericError; the duplicate transcript error line is hidden while the card owns it.

glob and grepSearch follow ripgrep 15.0.0 ignore and filter semantics (verified on real rg fixtures): include_gitignored, exclude_file_pattern, nested .gitignore/.ignore/.rgignore precedence and negation, git-repository boundaries, glob classes and braces, a 50-path glob cap, off-thread cancellable walks with a 20 s wall-clock bound.

Oversized browser screenshots fall back to JPEG qualities and halved capture scale within the 2 MiB transport and decoded-image bounds; the fallback keeps the captured area, retires on navigation and reports hidden-tab capture limits explicitly.
limits: The701-row scope and17331-function reference index remain preserved. Full semantic, line-by-line, pixel and identical reasoning parity is not established.
All live and packaged GUI claims remain historical until this exact new binary is separately exercised.

Search: .git and links are never listed even when include_gitignored; .gitignore applies without a repository (rg --no-require-git); git exclude and global gitignore are not read; a 20 s wall-clock bound is a native addition; upstream structured result objects (totalMatches, filesSearched) are not ported.
Screenshots: never-shown hidden tabs may not paint in WebView2 and report an explicit timeout; each fallback step recaptures rather than re-encoding one image.
Retry: fresh display id; saved selection dispatch; edit/replace and revert remain separate.
Sounds are synthesized ADE packs; real audio output not exercised in gates. Shortcuts S5/S6, tab pin and edit-nearest-message remain missing.
Background unread/error/waiting status, history edit/revert and local server discovery are in progress outside this cohort.
Cursor actual login/inference and remote services without credentials remain unverified.
